title: Nonnegativity of the probability norm
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite set, let $\pi$ be a probability distribution on $\Omega$, let $p\in\mathbb R$, and let $f:\Omega\to\mathbb R$. Define $\|f\|_{p,\pi}=\left(\sum_{x\in\Omega}\pi(x)|f(x)|^p\right)^{1/p}$, using real powers. Then $0\leq\|f\|_{p,\pi}$.
hypotheses_covered: $p$ is real, with no sign restriction
